title: Every class with code in base reaches the diagnostic mixin
owner: cairn (cairn/tools/base owns the classes; CC builds)
intention: Every class with code in cairn/tools/base reaches DiagnosticBase, so base's 18 classes can produce a diagnostic report when we are stuck and the every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve reads base green.
why: Akien 2026-10-27: 'any class with code it in should be able to run a diagnostic report when we need it' and 'everybody must inherit it. that's why it's a mixin.' The sieve from 339a45cee6a1 now holds PROVED for base, which blocks children 3 (632edb992aa3) and 1 (5dc4d8a0b4d2) of e41a94da3fd0.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured); Law 10 (nothing in the system is immeasurable); concept-piece CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass.md
how: Make diagnostic.py stdlib-only at load (D1, D4); add DiagnosticBase first in the bases of seven classes and IllegalTransition (D2); reorder BaseShim's bases (D3); accept loud setters on the frozen Workflow (D5); restate child 3's grammar tooth (D6); prove it (D7).
falsifier: Done when the sieve returns no findings for base, diagnostic.py's top-level imports are stdlib only, every converted exception keeps str, args and a pickle round-trip, Workflow keeps frozenness, equality and hash, every base module imports in a fresh interpreter, and no base proof green before the build is red after it. Wrong intent if inheriting the mixin changes any class's observable behaviour.
watchme: none, because the every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin sieve in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py already reds any base class that stops reaching the mixin, at every crossing for component base

decisions.text: D1: IMPORT-LIGHT AT LOAD. In cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py, delete the two module-level lines 'from cairn.tools.base.address import component_of_module' and 'from cairn.tools.base.breadcrumb_log import BreadcrumbLog'. Put 'from cairn.tools.base.address import component_of_module' as the first line inside the diagnostic_device property body, and 'from cairn.tools.base.breadcrumb_log import BreadcrumbLog' as the first line inside each method body that names BreadcrumbLog (find them with grep -n BreadcrumbLog cairn/tools/base/diagnostic.py; the address helpers diagnostic_trail uses get the same treatment). After the edit, diagnostic.py's top-level import statements are only 'from __future__ import annotations' and stdlib. Add one sentence to address.py's module docstring where it says it imports pathlib and nothing else: that it now also imports cairn.tools.base.diagnostic, which is itself stdlib-only at load, so the boot-order property holds.

D2: WHERE THE MIXIN GOES, AND IN WHICH POSITION. DiagnosticBase is added as the FIRST base, ahead of any builtin, so its cooperative __init__(*args, **kwargs) runs and chains through super() to the builtin's. Edits, each importing 'from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic import DiagnosticBase' at module top: workflow_grammar.py: 'class IllegalTransition(DiagnosticBase, ValueError)' (this converts all 11 transitions.py classes EntryGateRed, BuildGateRed, ExitGateRed, WatchmeEmissionRed, ProofNamedRed, WorkingTreeDirtyRed, TicketRequiredRed, ClearanceRequiredRed, DemoGateRed, FixmeGateRed, CastRefused, which all subclass it) and 'class Workflow(DiagnosticBase)' under its existing @dataclass(frozen=True); address.py: 'class AmbiguousComponent(DiagnosticBase, LookupError)'; breadcrumb_log.py: 'class BreadcrumbLog(DiagnosticBase)'; core_values.py: 'class CoreValuesMixin(DiagnosticBase)'; external.py: 'class ExternalParticipant(DiagnosticBase)'; gate_class.py: 'class TransitionGate(DiagnosticBase)'; probe.py: the nested 'class _Loud(DiagnosticBase, dict)'. MalformedWorkflow is not touched (no def in its body, so the sieve does not judge it). No class's own __init__ is changed.

D3: MRO REPAIR. cairn/tools/base/shim.py:206 'class BaseShim(DiagnosticBase, CoreValuesMixin, ABC)' becomes 'class BaseShim(CoreValuesMixin, DiagnosticBase, ABC)', the same order as BaseDevice at device.py:109. Without this, importing shim.py raises TypeError (cannot create a consistent method resolution order) once CoreValuesMixin inherits DiagnosticBase. Before editing, grep -rnE 'class \w+\(.*DiagnosticBase.*(CoreValuesMixin|TransitionGate|ExternalParticipant|BreadcrumbLog|IllegalTransition|Workflow)' over cairn bin skills; any further hit gets the same reorder.

D4: NOT_WIRED SURVIVES PICKLE. Add to class _NotWired in diagnostic.py: 'def __reduce__(self): return "NOT_WIRED"'. pickle treats a string from __reduce__ as the module-global name, so an unpickled exception's _diagnostic_receiver is the same NOT_WIRED object and the identity checks still hold.

D5: FROZEN DATACLASS. Workflow stays @dataclass(frozen=True). Its generated __init__ does not call DiagnosticBase.__init__; emit, diagnostic_records, held_diagnostics and diagnostic_trail work through the __dict__ lazy-init path. The explicit setters (set_diagnostic_receiver, set_diagnostic_instance, set_diagnostic_roots, set_trouble_notifier) assign with setattr and raise dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError on a Workflow; that is loud and accepted, and nothing in the repo calls them on a Workflow.

D6: CHILD 3's TOOTH 1 RESTATED. In cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_light_modules_keep_the_crossing_off_the_inspector_path.py, rename test_the_grammar_imports_only_the_standard_library to test_the_grammar_loads_nothing_that_posts (in the def, the check name and main()'s tuple). New body: collect the TOP-LEVEL import names of workflow_grammar.py (statements directly in ast.parse(...).body, not ast.walk) and require each to be stdlib, __future__, or exactly cairn.tools.base.diagnostic / cairn.tools.base.diagnostic.DiagnosticBase; then collect diagnostic.py's TOP-LEVEL import names the same way and require each to be stdlib or __future__. Fail with the stray names. Docstring line: Akien 2026-10-27, open-d32047bb1759, the inspector may write its own logs but not decide from them, so the grammar may carry the mixin as long as nothing that posts loads with it. Tooth 2 (ticket_file never reaches transitions, gate_probes, bus_client) is unchanged; measured 2026-10-27, import_sieve.reaches from diagnostic.py hits 11 files and none of those.

D7: THE PROOF. cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_base_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin.py, house runner shape (check() printing PASS/FAIL per tooth, a FAILURES list, main() catching each tooth's exception as a FAIL, exit 1 on any failure). Imports of the code under test happen inside each tooth. Teeth: (1) the sieve: from cairn.machines.build_inspector import inspector; inspector.every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin({'component': 'base', 'dir': 'cairn/tools/base'}, Path('cairn/tools/base')) returns [] (run with cwd at the repo root; print each finding's 'about' on failure). (2) diagnostic.py's top-level imports are stdlib or __future__ only. (3) each base module listed in D2 plus diagnostic, shim and device imports cleanly in a fresh interpreter: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'import <module>'], cwd=repo) returns 0 for each. (4) each of the 11 transitions exceptions and AmbiguousComponent: e = Cls('msg') (for classes whose __init__ needs more arguments, read its signature and pass the minimal ones) has str(e) and e.args equal to what ValueError/LookupError would give for the same message, isinstance(e, DiagnosticBase), and pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(e)) keeps args and str and its _diagnostic_receiver is NOT_WIRED. (5) Workflow: two equal Workflows (parse_workflow of the same string twice) are == and have equal hash, setattr on a field raises FrozenInstanceError, and w.emit('probe-gate') returns a dict without raising. (6) BaseShim's MRO lists CoreValuesMixin before DiagnosticBase.

D8: OUT OF SCOPE. The Probe root class stays as it is: the sieve already exempts it, per Akien 'determination isn't made at the rootmost level, but as each subclass needs' (open-d7983cf68dd2). The other 17 components the sieve reds (44 classes) are their own sibling tickets under 339a45cee6a1 D7. No behaviour change to any class beyond gaining the mixin.

PICKLE SCOPE, measured 2026-10-27. Before the build, pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(e)) round-trips the ten gate reds (EntryGateRed..FixmeGateRed) with equal args and str, but CastRefused round-trips with changed args/str and AmbiguousComponent raises TypeError (missing 'homes'), because their __init__ takes arguments args does not carry. The falsifier's 'pickle round-trip' therefore means: pickle behaviour unchanged by the build. D7 tooth 4 checks the round-trip and NOT_WIRED identity for the ten; for CastRefused and AmbiguousComponent it checks only str, args, isinstance. Making those two picklable is out of scope. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 (measurement settles proof shape).

D4 amended: _NotWired gets no __reduce__ (a method body would make the sentinel a class with code, and it cannot inherit the mixin it is the default of). Instead diagnostic.py imports copyreg and registers copyreg.pickle(_NotWired, lambda _: "NOT_WIRED") right after NOT_WIRED is assigned; the pickle round-trip still returns NOT_WIRED by identity. Found at build: the sieve read _NotWired red.
